titulo: Impact of sentinel pile on botulinum toxin treatment of chronic anal fissure: A comparative study

fig.label: Fig. 1
fig.caption: Sentinel pile in chronic anal fissure: representative clinical images. A typical CAF with the horizontal fibers of the IAS visible in its base. The skin inflammation and edema around the fissure are not regarded as SP (A); a typical CAF with prominent SP (B); an extreme, fibrotic, horny SP (C); and a rather inactive, chronic fissure—an intermediate lesion without overt inflammatory findings and visible IAS (incomplete healing) (D)
